description: Calculate hydrocarbon type composition from saturated/aromatic MS tables and fraction mass percentages.

input_file.description: Excel .xlsx workbook. Required sheets: saturate_ms (m/z, Intensity), aromatic_ms (m/z, Intensity), fractions (saturate_wt_percent, aromatic_wt_percent).

notes: m/z and Intensity are mass-spectrometric ion/intensity tables for saturated and aromatic fractions.
fractions provides the mass percentages used to combine saturated and aromatic results.
summary_compare is generated by the tool and is not an input sheet.

input_templates.label: Example input workbook
input_templates.description: Runnable workbook copied from the reviewed hydrocarbon type calculation tool package.
